entities.summary: Johann Jakob Humann was a German Roman Catholic clergyman. From 1806, he was vicar general of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Mainz and then Vicar Apostolic for the "redrawn" Roman Catholic Diocese of Speyer from 1817 to 1821. He also served as Mainz's Vicar Apostolic from 1818 to 1830 and briefly as its bishop in 1834.
